input.quote: Section 10.6 Submission to Jurisdiction. Each party submits to the nonexclusive jurisdiction of the United States District Court for the Southern District of New York and of any New York State Court sitting in New York, New York for legal proceedings relating to this Agreement.
input.rationale: Section 10.5 makes the Agreement governed by the internal laws of the State of New York (and bars any amendment changing the governing law), and Section 10.6 submits the parties to the U.S. District Court for the Southern District of New York and New York State courts sitting in New York, New York — the playbook's preferred New York law/New York County forum. The Article XI dispute resolution provisions are elective (the Requesting Party may choose mediation, binding arbitration or a legal proceeding) and any mediation or arbitration is held in New York, New York, so there is no mandatory or foreign-seated arbitration. Minor sub-element only: the jurisdiction grant is nonexclusive rather than exclusive, which is noted but not a material deviation and preserves our ability to sue elsewhere.
